snippet.title: DearBNB - Official Reveal Trailer Steam
snippet.description:
Steam Link : https://store.steampowered.com/app/4338180/Dearbnb

🏠 Build. Decorate. Profit.
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where every room you design brings you closer to a real estate empire.

- Start with a small apartment.
- Decorate freely.
- Watch tenants move in.

From poor districts to luxury neighborhoods, from apartments to cafes, cinemas, theme parks, aquaparks and massive commercial properties your empire grows room by room.

✨ No combat. No stress. Just smart decisions and cozy design.
Every choice affects comfort, value, and profit.

👉 Wishlist now on Steam
Turn one room into an empire.
